1. Tum Apne Jadd ke Makaa'n Mein Ho, Be Dayaar Nahi

2. Tumhare Pao'n Pakadti Hai, Sar Zameen e Haram

3. In Hajiyo Ki Zara Bhi, Nahi Hai Fikr Mujhe

4. Kaho Rabab Se Besheer Ko Bhi Le Ao

5. Ali Ko Qaidi Banaya Gaya Madine Mein

6. Karenge Jashn Ke Yaum e Ameer Hai Nazdeek
Ghareeb e Zehra Na Jao, Ghadeer Hai Nazdeek

7. Suna Hai Karbola Mein Bala Ki Garmi Hai
Tumhe Pata Hai ise Kitni Pyaas Lagti Hai

8. Laeen Phirte Hain Ehraam Mein Liye Khanjar

9. Jo Guzri Tum Pe Musibat Unhe Suna Dena
Samajh Ke Marqad e Zehra Diya Jala Dena
Yahi Hai Qabr e Khadija

Hussain Ruk Jao

10. Unhe Khabar Hai Na Chodengi Tum Ko Wo Tanha
Tumhari Maa Se Ziyada Chala Nahi Jaata
Hai Unka Phelu Shikasta

Hussain Ruk Jao

11. Wo Ghum Imaam Ka Sajjad Kis Tarha Likhhe
